text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You guys, you guys! Tomorrow the crepe
place is
going to be half off! We should
go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! I'll obviously have the El
Special!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El Special? Is that what you ordered last
time?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Claro! It's an egg and sausage crepe with
lots and
LOTS of hot sauce! The perfect
crepe for me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll get the vanilla ice cream crepe
made
with real Hokkaido milk! ♪ How
about you,
Grass?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I'll get the red bean and
matcha syrup
crepe. I just love how
subtle the sweetness is...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Japanese-style crepes do sound good! ♪
All
right, I can't wait until tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, then you'd better get studying...
Failing
tomorrow's quiz will result in
extra lessons, and
that means no crepes.
